title: Figma mock-ups: yes for looking, no as a second source of truth

owner_note.text: Only 6 of the 36 Figma pages have code and 17 more are only mentioned in docs; 5 of 24 Figma variables match the site by name and value (prime, error, ok, warn, surface), dark and light differ, and spacing is fixed in Figma but fluid on the site. Recommendation: keep Figma as the place to look at and approve a design, but keep code the one source for tokens and shipped pages, coding each approved frame straight away; the alternative is mocking up as live pages with Shots, cheaper and no drift but no canvas to rearrange. I asked the Figma agents to decide dark and fluid vs fixed next.
